Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

equal adjective

the same in size, number or value

also equal to, be equal to, a match for, equality, even (of numbers), equal shares, be on a level with someone

classical

Cic. Rep. 1.49: jūra certē paria dēbent esse
Cic. Sen. 7: parēs … cum paribus facillimē congregantur

pār, paris

adjective, third declension, one ending; with a dative or cum

equal, a match for; even (of numbers)

Equal in size, number, strength or rank, and so a match for someone: verbum Latīnum pār Graecō (Cic. Fin. 2.12, Lewis & Short). Pār impār is the game of odd or even (Hor. S. 2.3.248). Its neuter noun is a pair (see pair).

Other words

  • aequus, aequa, aequum — equal, even; level; fair

    adjective, declension · also used · classical · Caes. B.G. 1.43.1: aequum ferē spatium; Cic. Off. 1.30: quod dubitēs aequum sit an inīquum

    Its first sense is level, flat (aequus locus); then equal, of shares, distances and terms; and above all fair, reasonable (aequum est, it is right) and calm (aequō animō) (Lewis & Short). For equal in size or number pār is the plainer word.

  • aequālis, aequāle — equal, like; of the same age

    adjective, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Or. 188: partem pedis aut aequālem esse alterī partī; Cic. Sen. 10: ut aequālem, like a man of my own age (Lewis & Short)

    Most often “of the same age”, “contemporary” (aequālis meus, Ter., Cic.); as “equal” it is a word of measures and parts.

Examples

  • sī ingenia omnium paria esse nōn possunt, jūra certē paria dēbent esse eōrum inter sē, quī sunt cīvēs in eādem rē pūblicā

    if everyone’s talents cannot be equal, the rights of those who are citizens of the same state should at least be equal among themselvesCic. Rep. 1.49

  • parēs autem vetere prōverbiō cum paribus facillimē congregantur

    and equals, as the old proverb says, flock together most easily with equalsCic. Sen. 7

  • lūdere pār inpār

    to play odd or evenHor. S. 2.3.248

  • pār esse alicuī

    to be on a level with someoneTraupman 339

See also same, pair, distance.
